Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Wow! It's all nice and clean!"
Sisk: "Of course. Mr. Bart got all sorts of things ready,
so we finished sooner than I expected."
Touya: "Huh... So now you'll be able to cook
a bigger variety of dishes?"
Sisk: "Yes. You can look forward to it."
Xiujian: "...Is it fixed?"
Touya: "Hmm? Hey, were you curious about it too?"
Xiujian: "Of course. Food nurtures a sound mind
and builds a healthy body. I cannot believe anyone
would neglect it."
You've got a point.
Really?
Xiujian: "Hmm. Food, nurtured by heaven's blessings and the earth's love,
is the first happiness granted to people. Too many forget that,
and take it for granted..."
Xiujian: "...How lamentable...
Food is nurtured by heaven's blessings and the earth's love,
the first happiness granted to people.
Forgetting that and taking it for granted
is a flaw in the thinking of people today."
Sisk: "Wow! Well said!
I feel like we'd have a lot to talk about!
Oh, right. Come over here a moment!"
Xiujian: "Huh... Oh, no..."
Yamato: "Oh... They're gone...
Where did she take him, I wonder?"
Touya: "...Who knows? Well, let's go somewhere else too."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
I wonder if someone's on it."
Touya: "Of course people use it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's always stopped.
And right on that floor, too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To protect the one I love, my blade of justice strikes the enemy!
With red blood burning crimson, such is the way a man must live!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I have arrived! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You should have Gabon take a look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I am the very picture of health!
I'm not so weak that I'd get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm quite confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It wasn't bad at all.
Sounds like enka.
Fain: "Doesn't it? That last part in particular
gives even me a thrill when I say it."
Yamato: "He's intoxicated with himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep it up."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... If I had to describe it, maybe 'a song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? You mean a song that resonates
directly with the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation
is that wonderful too!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice is also for protecting the people dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. People dear to you, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice
is not so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better stay away..."
Fain: "But we're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who should I fight for?
I've decided in my heart to love only one woman.
And yet, I have the noble, supreme duty
of protecting the princess. I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What an ordeal! Such is the destiny of a knight!
Then I shall press on! To fight against fate!
No, wait. But my master also said that wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything.
Does that mean I must commit myself to one or the other?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And to choose between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! All of this is because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If they weren't around, I would never have had to
suffer like this...
Wait! Could this be their plot?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will not let something like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their plan against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess,
all at the same time?
No, but that would go against my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it rough too."
Touya: "Well, I guess his life's pretty fulfilling in its own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "Hmm? Isn't that... Fain?"
Yamato: "It is... But he just came out of Kasumi's room,
didn't he?"
Touya: "...That's what it looked like to me too."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan. What's up?"
Touya: "Looks like Fain just came out of there..."
Kasumi: "Yes, he did."
Yamato: "Kasumi, are you and Fain...?"
Kasumi: "Hmm? Fain-kun only helped me
carry my things.
Is something wrong with that?"
Touya: "Your things?"
Kasumi: "I could manage my clothes and things by myself,
but I couldn't carry all my books...
And then Fain-kun happened to come by."
Touya: "And he offered to carry them for you, right?"
Kasumi: "Yes. How did you know?"
Touya: "Well, after seeing how he was acting earlier,
I don't think he'd have just left you there."
Kasumi: "Fain-kun reminds me of you in some ways, Touya-chan."
Touya: "Really?"
Kasumi: "Yes. You're both open and honest, and kind."
Yamato: "I think he has a very clear goal
behind his actions, though..."
Kasumi: "?"
Touya: "Are all your things taken care of now?
I'll help if there's anything else."
Kasumi: "No, it's fine. I just need to put things in order now."
Touya: "Okay. Well, if you need anything, don't hesitate to ask."
Kasumi: "Yeah, I will."
Touya: "See you."
Touya: "Hey."
Celica: "Oh, Touya. What's up?"
Touya: "Hmm? Well, I don't really need anything."
Celica: "Hmm. Then I hereby assign you the mission
of keeping this seat warm in my place."
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "You're free, aren't you?"
Touya: "I'm not that free. See you!"
Celica: "Oh..."
Celica: "Are you wandering around looking for someone new to meet, maybe?"
Touya: "Of course not!"
Celica: "True. Touya, you don't really seem like the type
to go actively looking for love."
Touya: "Then what do I seem like?"
Celica: "Hmm... Things you do without thinking much about them
move someone's heart, and before you know it, things work out.
Touya: "As if anything that convenient ever happens."
Celica: "Well, you'll find out eventually.
Now then, I'd better get going."
